beginning.title: 1. The Beginning
beginning.paragraph1: Florlen started with a simple idea: handcrafting the future of collectibles, one stitch at a time.
beginning.paragraph2: We believe in slow-fashion, sustainable practices, and creating unique companions designed by you, handmade with love.

craft.title: 2. The Craft
craft.paragraph1: Every piece is meticulously crafted by our skilled artisans. We use only the finest organic cotton yarn and ensure every detail is perfect.
craft.paragraph2: We take pride in our work and strive to deliver the best quality products to our customers.

vision.title: 3. Our Vision
vision.paragraph1: To build a community of collectors and creators who appreciate the art of handmade goods, and to bring joy through personalized, high-quality crochet companions.

general.title: 1. General Care
general.paragraph1: Your Florlen companion is handmade with love and needs a little care to stay looking its best. Follow these simple instructions to keep your crochet piece clean and intact.

washing.title: 2. Washing
washing.item1: 2.1 Hand wash only using cold or lukewarm water.
washing.item3: 2.3 Gently squeeze the water through the item. Do not wring or scrub.

drying.title: 3. Drying
drying.item1: 3.1 Press out excess water gently with a clean towel.
drying.item2: 3.2 Lay flat to dry on a dry towel in a shaded area.
drying.item3: 3.3 Do not tumble dry or place in direct sunlight.

reshaping.title: 4. Reshaping
reshaping.paragraph1: While the item is still damp, gently pull and pat it back into its original shape. Do not iron.

general.title: 1. General Terms
general.paragraph1: At Florlen, we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.
general.paragraph2: By accessing or using our website, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy.

collecting.title: 2. Information We Collect
collecting.paragraph1: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact customer support. This may include your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment information.

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
usage.item1: 3.1 To process and fulfill your orders.
usage.item2: 3.2 To communicate with you about your order status.
usage.item3: 3.3 To send you promotional emails (if you have opted in).
usage.item4: 3.4 To improve our website and customer service.

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.paragraph1: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

delivery.title: 1. General Delivery Terms
delivery.paragraph1: We ship our handmade companions worldwide. Here is everything you need to know about our shipping and delivery processes.

processing.title: 2. Processing Time
processing.paragraph1: Because every item is meticulously handcrafted to order, please allow 5-10 business days for your companion to be created before it is shipped.

item1.label: Domestic (Vietnam):
item1.text: 2-4 business days. Standard shipping fee applies.

item2.label: International:
item2.text: 7-15 business days depending on the destination country. Shipping fees are calculated at checkout.

tracking.title: 4. Tracking Your Order
tracking.paragraph1: Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking information so you can monitor your package's journey.

commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
commitment.paragraph1: At Florlen, sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We believe in slow-fashion, which means creating high-quality pieces that are made to last, rather than mass-produced items that end up in landfills.

materials.title: 2. Materials
materials.paragraph1: We use 100% organic cotton yarn and eco-friendly dyes. Our packaging is made from recycled materials and is fully recyclable or compostable.

ethical.title: 3. Ethical Practices
ethical.paragraph1: Our artisans are paid fair wages and work in safe, comfortable conditions. We are committed to supporting our local communities and empowering women through our craft.

general.title: 1. General
general.paragraph1: Welcome to Florlen! By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. These terms govern your use of the Florlen website and the purchase of any products from us.
general.paragraph2: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time.

products.title: 2. Products and Pricing
products.item1: 2.1 All our products are handcrafted, which means there may be slight variations between the product images and the actual item you receive.
products.item2: 2.2 Prices are subject to change without notice.

orders.title: 3. Orders and Payments
orders.paragraph1: When you place an order, you agree to provide current, complete, and accurate purchase and account information. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order.

returns.title: 4. Return Policy
returns.paragraph1: Due to the custom, handmade nature of our products, we generally do not accept returns. However, if your item arrives damaged, please contact us within 7 days of delivery to discuss a replacement or refund.
